architecture_pattern.definition: A reusable arrangement with no adoption, operation or semantic-owner identity.

capability.definition: Typed behavior required or offered by products and implementations.

implementation.definition: A concrete project or component requiring qualification.

interface.definition: A versioned interaction contract without an operated promise.

library_contract.definition: A pure or effect-bounded reusable implementation boundary.

neighboring_product.definition: A product outside this slice whose authority is imported rather than re-owned.

product.definition: An independently adopted and operated outcome promise that remains a candidate until ratified.

provider_class.definition: A class of operated offers, not a qualified occurrence.

resource_class.definition: A finite runtime or persistence resource requirement.

semantic_contract.definition: Owner of meanings, states, invariants and refusals.

solution_pack.definition: A vertical composition carrying industry language, rules, sources and defaults.

standard.definition: An exact external edition that specializes an interface or semantic contract.

suite.definition: Commercial or operational packaging of independently governed products.
